before.name: Gaius Gracchus elected Roman tribune for the first time. He waits until after his re-election the following year before pushing forward the various civil and agrarian reforms that his brother championed in 133 BC

after.name: Gaius Gracchus: plebeian tribune in 123–122 BC; election timing needs verification

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The imported 133 BC claim confuses Gaius with his brother Tiberius, tribune in 133. Gaius held the plebeian tribunate in 123 and 122; this is an office interval and does not establish the election date. Re-election and reform chronology require further review.
